snippet.title: FiresOut! - Official Game Trailer
snippet.description:
FiresOut! is a fast-paced, chaotic, and laugh-out-loud local co-op firefighting game where teamwork makes the dream work... or total disaster! Inspired by games like Overcooked and Moving Out, grab your gear and your best buddy as you dive into burning houses, dodge fireballs, and rescue helpless victims from fire monsters run amok.

Do you have what it takes to become a certified firefighting intern duo? Or will your friendship go up in flames?

🫱🏻‍🫲🏼 Chaotic 2-Player Local Co-Op – Play side-by-side with a friend and test your coordination, patience, and friendship!

🔥 Fire Monster Antics – The fire monster doesn’t wait! It throws fireballs around the house, constantly reshaping the environment and your strategy.

🆘 Rescue Missions – Smash through obstacles, extinguish flames, and carry victims to safety. Just try not to trip over each other!

🧯 Mr. Glug Glug – Your trusty fire extinguisher isn’t just a tool — he’s your squishy water-spitting colleague!

🪓 Hilarious Physics – Expect silly falls, heroic saves, and moments that make you both scream and laugh.

🕹️ Controller Support – Best played with a controller for that couch co-op feel. Online play is possible using Parsec.

🧠 Strategy Meets Chaos - Plan your rescue — or just wing it! Coordinate with your teammate or don’t — sometimes chaos is half the fun!

----------------------------------------

Wishlist FiresOut! now - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3983200/FiresOut/
